description: Search complete source-defined Q&A pairs, numbered selections and extracts. Terms may occur in different component passages—for example, one in a question and another in its answer. Results return the individually cited components. Coverage: The Kitáb-i-Aqdas Q&A, The Hidden Words selections, and extracts in To Set the World in Order: Building and Preserving Strong Marriages. Additional reviewed compilation extracts: Social Action, Family Life, and Women.

author.description: Keep units where every component passage has this recorded author. Accepts a name, recognized alias or contributor ID. Name matching normalizes case, punctuation and diacritics; Bahaullah matches Bahá’u’lláh. Only scoped author roles qualify, including supported derived assignments; publication credits and on-behalf-of responsibility do not qualify. Unknown/conflicting scope is excluded. Every component must match.
author.title: Author

cursor.description: Continue from a returned next_cursor, keeping all other arguments unchanged.
cursor.title: Cursor

document_id.description: Restrict results to units from one document ID.
document_id.title: Document Id

document_type.description: Filter by the exact recorded document type.
document_type.title: Document Type

language.description: Strict exact passage language from the versioned evidence projection when installed, otherwise source-recorded language. Unknown/conflicting values are excluded; hints and website locale are not text language. Zero results do not establish source absence. Every component, including markers, must match.
language.title: Language

limit.description: Maximum units per page, from 1 to 10.
limit.title: Limit

phrase.description: Match the query words as one adjacent phrase in the normalized unit text.
phrase.title: Phrase

query.description: Words to find across a source unit. Accepts 1–64 searchable terms. Example: sick permissible can match terms divided between a question and its answer.
query.title: Query

responsibility.description: Filter by a publication contributor in any recorded role, such as author, issuer, compiler or translator. Accepts a name, recognized alias or contributor ID. Name matching normalizes case, punctuation and diacritics; Bahaullah matches Bahá’u’lláh.
responsibility.title: Responsibility

name: search_passage_groups
